case_evidence.description: Frozen Python 1.2 src/eyetrajectoriespy/workflows/_core.py::export_workflow_bundle; Native Python 1.2 checksummed workflow bundle exporter extended from dense FPCA to strict fixed-bandwidth paired sparse multivariate PACE source-scientific workflows with actual R estimator, canonical typed portable nested fit and measured native scientific audit.

Rejects native RDS-only alternatives under python_1_2, noncanonical result, unsupported optional mode, destination overwrite and path collisions.

New source-pinned Python 1.2 test opens exported Python workflow.json and JSON+NPZ portable result with Python `load_portable_result`, verifies Python dataclass outer and nested scientific type field order, covariance numerical arrays, score metadata and native step payload, and recursively SHA256 checks the bundle; R standalone source tests compare nested real scientific arrays and all file integrity hashes. CI is queued/not observed green.

Refuses unsupported workflow classes, unmeasured source step, mandatory scientific fields missing, unsupported score modes, unsafe filenames, overwrite, arbitrary Python runtime types; distinct R-specific exceptions and runtime class identity are recorded as limitations.

Published frozen Python 1.2 WORKFLOW_BUNDLE_FORMAT, schema version, workflow contract, result_type, figure-export-deferred status, config.json, provenance.json, environment.json with explicit R rather than fake Python identity, source tables/reports, steps.csv, decisions.csv, result/arrays.npz, result/manifest.json and recursive SHA256SUMS. Serialized nested source workflow dataclasses, source fit, decisions, provenance and score table are recoverable in pinned Python reader.

Workflow bundle carries genuine paired sparse planar joint covariance and PACE score estimates with source scientific steps, decisions, fixed-bandwidth analyst choices, source score reports and tables, no substitute marginal interpolation estimator or raw Python object rehydration.
